summary: Fermi Inc. filed a Form 8-K to announce the date of its 2026 annual meeting of stockholders, set for October 30, 2026, with a record date of August 31, 2026, and deadlines for Rule 14a-8 proposals and director nominations of September 10, 2026. The filing is a routine administrative notice regarding meeting logistics and stockholder proposal deadlines, not a special-situation event. No equity transactions, strategic actions, or management changes are involved. The disclosure comports with standard governance procedures for public companies and requires no further analysis.
